summary: BioVie Inc. filed Amendment No. 2 to a prospectus supplement (424B5) trimming its at-the-market program with sole sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners to up to $285,000 of common stock, down from $1,225,000 previously registered under the September 11, 2026 sales agreement. Shares trade on Nasdaq as BIVI; last reported sale price was $1.34 on November 4, 2026, with public float of roughly $17.9 million. The amendment reflects compliance with Form S-3 Instruction I.B.6's one-third float cap; no board recommendation or advisor beyond the agent. This is a routine shelf takedown revision rather than a special situation, though dilution and continued ATM usage overhang remain the watch items.
